weekly.description.0.en: Please also report if you had/have no complaints.

weekly.Q1.title.0.en: Do you currently have, or have you had in the past week, one or more of the following symptoms?

weekly.Q1.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.Q1.helpGroup.text.1.en: The most important part of this study is following up on the symptoms you have reported.

weekly.Q1.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

weekly.Q1.helpGroup.text.3.en: If you suffer from a chronic illness only indicate the symptoms that have changed. For example, if you suffer from chronic shortness of breath only report this symptom if it has recently gotten worse. Multiple answers are possible.

weekly.Q1.rg.cGJZ.text.0.en: Do you currently have, or have you had during the past week, any of the following symptoms? Multiple answers are possible. Please select only symptoms that have appeared recently or have worsened.

weekly.HS.Q2.title.0.en: When you filled out the previous questionnaire, you indicated that you were still sick. Are the symptoms you are reporting now from the same timeframe as the symptoms you reported the last time?

weekly.HS.Q2.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.HS.Q2.helpGroup.text.1.en: To speed up the completion of the rest of the questionnaire.

weekly.HS.Q2.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

weekly.HS.Q2.helpGroup.text.3.en: If you think that the complaints you are indicating today are caused by the same infection or the same problem (the same period during which you experienced the complaints), answer 'yes'.

weekly.HS.Q2.rg.scg.option.3.en: This does not apply to me

weekly.HS.Qcov3.title.0.en: In the 14 days before your symptoms started, have you been in close contact with someone who has tested positive for Covid-19 with an antigenic or PCR test?

weekly.HS.Qcov3.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.HS.Qcov3.helpGroup.text.1.en: In  order to investigate how the coronavirus spreads within the general population.

weekly.HS.Qcov3b.title.0.en: Was this person or one of these persons a member of your household?

weekly.HS.Qcov3b.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.HS.Qcov3b.helpGroup.text.1.en: The coronavirus and the flu (influenza) spread quickly indoors.

weekly.HS.Qcov3b.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

weekly.HS.Qcov3b.helpGroup.text.3.en: A member of the household is defined as a person (not necessarily a family member) who lives at the same address as you, and with whom you share the kitchen, the living room, the family room/dining room.

weekly.HS.Q3.title.0.en: On what day did you experience the first symptoms? If you do not recall the exact date, please provide an approximate date.

weekly.HS.Q3.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.HS.Q3.helpGroup.text.1.en: This question will help us to determine how many people are experiencing flu-like symptoms per day/week.

weekly.HS.Q3.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

weekly.HS.Q4.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.HS.Q4.helpGroup.text.1.en: We can use the first and last dates of the occurance of your symptoms to calculate how long your symptoms lasted.

weekly.HS.Q4.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

weekly.HS.Q5.title.0.en: Did your symptoms develop suddenly over a few hours?

weekly.HS.Q5.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.HS.Q5.helpGroup.text.1.en: The sudden onset of symptoms (within a few hours) is linked to the coronavirus and influenza.

weekly.HS.Q5.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

weekly.HS.Q5.helpGroup.text.3.en: Answer "yes" if your symptoms appeared within a few hours, and not gradually over a period of several days.

weekly.HS.Q6.title.0.en: On what day did your fever start? If you do not recall the exact date, please provide an approximate date.

weekly.HS.Q6.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.HS.Q6.helpGroup.text.1.en: Fever is an important diagnostic symptom - therefore we would like to know when the fever first appeared.

weekly.HS.Q6.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

weekly.HS.Q6b.title.0.en: Did your fever develop suddenly over a few hours?

weekly.HS.Q6b.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.HS.Q6b.helpGroup.text.1.en: The sudden onset of symptoms (within a few hours) is linked to the coronavirus and influenza.

weekly.HS.Q6b.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

weekly.HS.Q6b.helpGroup.text.3.en: Answer "yes" if your symptoms appeared within a few hours, and not gradually over a period of several days.

weekly.HS.Q6c.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.HS.Q6c.helpGroup.text.1.en: If you have measured your temperature (fever), we would like to know the highest body temperature that you have measured.

weekly.HS.Q6c.helpGroup.text.3.en: Answer yes, if you measured your temperature (fever) using a thermometer.

weekly.HS.Q6d.title.0.en: What was the highest temperature you have measured?

weekly.HS.Q6d.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.HS.Q6d.helpGroup.text.1.en: Certain infectious diseases cause a raised body-temperature (fever).

weekly.HS.Q6d.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

weekly.HS.Q6d.helpGroup.text.3.en: Please indicate the highest temperature you have measured during the period in which you have experienced flu-like symptoms.

weekly.HS.Q36.title.0.en: Thank you for all this information. It will help us estimate the frequency of symptoms within the general population. You can stop here. If you have some more time, we propose to you to answer some further questions about your symptoms and care. Do you wish to continue to answer these additional questions?

weekly.HS.Q36.helpGroup.text.1.en: We want to know if you are willing to answer some further questions. Your answers to these follow-up questions assist our research.

weekly.EX.Q7.title.0.en: Because of your symptoms, did you VISIT (see face to face or teleconsultation) any medical services?

weekly.EX.Q7.helpGroup.text.1.en: To find out whether people contact health services because of their symptoms.

weekly.EX.Q7.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

weekly.EX.Q7.helpGroup.text.3.en: Check all of the answers that apply. If you have already made an appointment then check the final option.

weekly.EX.Q7.rg.mcg.option.1.en: Generalist medical practitioners or nurse practitioner

weekly.EX.Q7.rg.mcg.option.3.en: Hospital accident & emergency department - out of hours service

weekly.EX.Q7.rg.mcg.option.5.en: No, but I have an appointment scheduled

weekly.EX.Q7b.title.0.en: How soon after your symptoms appeared did you first VISIT medical support?

weekly.EX.Q7b.helpGroup.text.1.en: To find out how quickly people with flu-like symptoms seek medical help.

weekly.EX.Q7b.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

weekly.EX.Q7b.helpGroup.text.3.en: Only indicate the time until your FIRST contact with the health services.

weekly.EX.Q7b.rg.sFcN.text.0.en: Select the correct number of days

weekly.EX.Q7b.rg.mat.r1.col0.label.0.en: Generalist medical practitioners or nurse practitioner

weekly.EX.Q7b.rg.mat.r2.col0.label.0.en: Hospital accident & emergency department - out of hours service

weekly.EX.Qcov18.title.0.en: What is the main reason why you did not consult any health professional in regards to the symptoms you have listed today?

weekly.EX.Qcov18.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.EX.Qcov18.helpGroup.text.1.en: To understand why some people do not consult a doctor/seek medical help.

weekly.EX.Qcov18.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

weekly.EX.Qcov18.rg.scg.option.3.en: I think I know what I have and I self-medicate

weekly.EX.Qcov18.rg.scg.option.4.en: I believe there is no effective treatment for the disease I have

weekly.EX.Qcov18.rg.scg.option.5.en: It is too hard to get an appointment quickly

weekly.EX.Qcov18.rg.scg.option.8.en: Out of fear of consequences if the doctor thinks I have Covid-19

weekly.EX.Qcov18.rg.scg.option.9.en: Because I am vaccinated against Covid-19

weekly.EX.Qcov18.rg.scg.option.11.en: I don't know / I don't want to answer

weekly.EX.Qcov16h.title.0.en: Because of your symptoms, did you undergo a test/analyses to test if you have Covid-19?

weekly.EX.Qcov16h.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.EX.Qcov16h.helpGroup.text.1.en: We want to investigate which symptoms motivate people to get tested for coronavirus.

weekly.EX.Qcov16h.rg.scg.option.1.en: Not yet, but I plan to shortly take a test

weekly.EX.Qcov16h.rg.scg.option.2.en: No, and even though I have a prescription I will not undergo a test

weekly.EX.Qcov16i.title.0.en: What kind of Covid-19-test/-analyse(s) did you do?

weekly.EX.Qcov16i.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.EX.Qcov16i.helpGroup.text.1.en: We are interested in knowing how many people who experience flu-like symptoms have taken a test

weekly.EX.Qcov16i.rg.mcg.option.0.en: A PCR test (virus search, on a swab in nose or mouth, or a sputum or saliva sample)

weekly.EX.Qcov16i.rg.mcg.option.1.en: A serological analysis (screening for antibodies against this virus with a blood sample)

weekly.EX.Qcov16i.rg.mcg.option.2.en: A rapid antigen test based on a nasal swab (nasopharyngeal sampling, done by a health professional or a trained person with a swab inserted up to 15 cm into the nose and the result is obtained in less than one hour)

weekly.EX.Qcov16i.rg.mcg.option.3.en: A rapid antigen test or autotest based on a nasal sample (a swab inserted to 1 - 4 cm into the nostril, sampling can be done by oneself, result obtained within a few minutes)

weekly.EX.Qcov16b.title.0.en: Do you know the result of your PCR test? (If several were performed and at least one was positive, check the “Positive” answer)

weekly.EX.Qcov16b.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.EX.Qcov16b.helpGroup.text.1.en: We want to understand how the coronavirus is spreading within the population.

weekly.EX.Qcov16b.rg.scg.option.2.en: Yes, but the results are inconclusive.

weekly.EX.Qcov16b.rg.scg.option.3.en: No, I have not yet received the test results.

weekly.EX.Qcov16f.title.0.en: Do you know the result of this rapid antigen detection test on nasopharyngeal sample? (If several were performed and at least one was positive, check the “Positive” answer)

weekly.EX.Qcov16f.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.EX.Qcov16f.helpGroup.text.1.en: We want to understand how the coronavirus is spreading within the population.

weekly.EX.Qcov16f.rg.scg.option.2.en: Yes, but the results are inconclusive.

weekly.EX.Qcov16f.rg.scg.option.3.en: I don't know / I don't want to answer

weekly.EX.Qcov16k.title.0.en: Do you know the result of this antigenic test or self-test based on a nasal sample? (If several were performed and at least one was positive, check the “Positive” answer)

weekly.EX.Qcov16k.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.EX.Qcov16k.helpGroup.text.1.en: We want to understand how the coronavirus is spreading within the population.

weekly.EX.Qcov16k.rg.scg.option.2.en: Yes, but the results are inconclusive

weekly.EX.Qcov16k.rg.scg.option.3.en: I don't know / I don't want to answer

weekly.EX.Qcov19.title.0.en: Because of your symptoms, did you undergo a test/analyses to know if you have the flu (influenza)?

weekly.EX.Qcov19.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.EX.Qcov19.helpGroup.text.1.en: We want to know which complaints lead people to get tested for the flu (influenza).

weekly.EX.Qcov19.rg.scg.option.0.en: Yes, a PCR test based on a swab in nose or mouth, or a sputum or saliva sample.

weekly.EX.Qcov19.rg.scg.option.1.en: Yes, a rapid detection test (result available in less than an hour).

weekly.EX.Qcov19.rg.scg.option.2.en: Not yet, but I have a prescription and plan to shortly undergo a test.

weekly.EX.Qcov19.rg.scg.option.3.en: No, I have a prescription but will not undergo a test.

weekly.EX.Qcov19b.title.0.en: Have you received the results of your flu (Influenza) test?

weekly.EX.Qcov19b.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.EX.Qcov19b.helpGroup.text.1.en: We want to understand how the flu is spreading within the population.

weekly.EX.Qcov19b.rg.scg.option.0.en: Yes, the test is positive for Influenza.

weekly.EX.Qcov19b.rg.scg.option.1.en: Yes, the test is negative for Influenza.

weekly.EX.Qcov19b.rg.scg.option.2.en: Yes, but the results are inconclusive.

weekly.EX.Qcov19b.rg.scg.option.3.en: No, I have not yet received the test results.

weekly.EX.Q9.title.0.en: Did you take medication for these symptoms?

weekly.EX.Q9.helpGroup.text.1.en: To find out who gets treated, and how effective that treatment is.

weekly.EX.Q9.helpGroup.text.3.en: Only record those medications that you used because of your flu-like symptoms. If you are on other medications because of a pre-existing illness then do not indicate these here.

weekly.EX.Q9.rg.mcg.option.1.en: Pain killers (e.g. paracetamol, lemsip, ibuprofen, aspirin, calpol, etc)

weekly.EX.Q14.title.0.en: Were you hospitalized because of your symptoms?

weekly.EX.Q14.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.EX.Q14.helpGroup.text.1.en: We want to understand the rates of hospitalization due to symptoms

weekly.EX.Q10.title.0.en: Did you change your daily routine because of your illness?

weekly.EX.Q10.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.EX.Q10.helpGroup.text.1.en: To determine how the symptoms are impacting your daily life.

weekly.EX.Q10.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

weekly.EX.Q10.helpGroup.text.3.en: We want to know if you have missed work/school due to your symptoms, or if you have modified your daily routine in any way (for example, if you were unable to engage in sport activities). If you are a student, and were unable to attend online classes due to your symptoms, you should also select option 2. We are interested in changes due to your symptoms/complaints and not due to any quarantine.

weekly.EX.Q10.rg.scg.option.0.en: No, I was able to go about my daily activities as usual

weekly.EX.Q10.rg.scg.option.1.en: Yes, but I did not take time off work/school

weekly.EX.Q10.rg.scg.option.2.en: Yes, I took time off work/school

weekly.EX.Q10b.title.0.en: Are you currently still unable to work/attend school due to your symptoms/complaints?

weekly.EX.Q10b.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.EX.Q10b.helpGroup.text.1.en: To determine how your symptoms are impacting your daily life.

weekly.EX.Q10b.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

weekly.EX.Q10b.helpGroup.text.3.en: Answer "yes" if you missed work/school today due to the symptoms you are currently experiencing.

weekly.EX.Q10b.rg.scg.option.2.en: Other (I did not have to work/school today)

weekly.EX.Q10c.title.0.en: For how many days have you been unable to work normally/go to school (when you otherwise would have)?

weekly.EX.Q10c.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.EX.Q10c.helpGroup.text.1.en: To calculate the number of days a person misses work/school due to certain symptoms.

weekly.EX.Q10c.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

weekly.EX.Q10c.helpGroup.text.3.en: Only count the days that you would otherwise have gone to work/school. Please provide an estimate as precise as possible.

weekly.EX.Qcov7.title.0.en: Did you begin to follow or increase any of the measures below because of your symptoms (compared to the period before your had symptoms)?

weekly.EX.Qcov7.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.EX.Qcov7.helpGroup.text.1.en: To examine how different measures are being followed.

weekly.EX.Qcov7.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

weekly.EX.Qcov7.helpGroup.text.3.en: For example, for 'Avoid shaking hands': Answer 'Yes, I am following this measure now for the first time, or in a stricter way' if you shake hands less or not at all because of your symptoms; Answer 'No, I am not following this measure' if you continue to shake hands despite your symptoms; Answer 'No, I was already following this measure before' if you had already stopped shaking hands before the onset of your symptoms and you did not change this behaviour.

weekly.EX.Q11.title.0.en: What do you think is causing your symptoms?

weekly.EX.Q11.helpGroup.text.0.en: Why are we asking this question?

weekly.EX.Q11.helpGroup.text.1.en: To see if our assessment of your illness based on your symptoms matches with what you believe is causing them. You may have a better idea/understanding of what the cause might be than our computer algorithms.

weekly.EX.Q11.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

weekly.EX.Q11.helpGroup.text.3.en: If you are reasonably sure of the cause of your symptoms, select the appropriate option. Otherwise, select 'No, I don’t know'.

weekly.surveyEnd.title.0.en: Once submitted, this week’s questionnaire is complete. You will be asked to complete it again next week. Thank you for your support!
